Nina (AE): BetaOne POC hit 429s and free credits went to 0 mid-demo. Demo froze. Need quick triage.
Omar (Solutions): org=betaone-9, they used streaming chat + embedding. Any SDK logs?
Nina (AE): customer attached this snippet: 
```
client.chat.stream(...)
client.embeddings.create(...)
// retry wrapper resends on socket close
```
They said hotel wifi flapped.
spend-alert-bot: Spend alert: org=betaone-9 at 1855551299, remaining_free=0
Tess (Billing): Free tokens consumed=820412. I can add a demo credit if we need. Hold invoicing.
Lee (SRE): quick triage: metering shows repeated token events with no request id. Reconnects look like duplicated chunks.
Omar (Solutions): can we give them a short explainer and mitigation steps to send to infra?
Lee (SRE): draft: "During the demo the client's device reconnected and retried streaming calls without a stable request id, causing duplicate token accounting. Immediate fixes: add a unique X-Request-ID per logical op and avoid running large embed batches during live demos. We've applied a temporary credit."
Tess (Billing): applied +150k token credit and muted alerts for 30m. billing-note added.
Nina (AE): sending that to the customer now. They want timeline for permanent fix.
Lee (SRE): plan: accept client idempotency header in canary (ETA ~4h), server-side short dedupe window (ETA ~2 days), update quickstart (ETA ~1 day). Opening ticket POC-712.
Nina (AE): customer reran demo after credit and it completed. Leaving thread open to confirm no further alerts. :thumbsup:
